description: Take the ultimate selfie with Camera Remote for Olympus cameras! Enables Live control of your camera via WiFi. Camera Remote allows you to remotely control your Olympus camera via a Wi-Fi connection. Useful for group photos, tripod shots (avoiding camera shake) and other scenarios where a remote trigger control might otherwise be required. See exactly what you're going to take with Live View, take the photo remotely and then instantly review it on your Windows device screen to ensure you've got the photo you want. Features ?
